title: Display label characters on the page
goal: uses HTML character quotation to display a line of source code for readers to copy.
summary: The browser will parse tags and character references like &. Use <, >, & to display <, >, & on the page.
tasks:
displays this source code "

©

" in the existing code.
Use character references to retain the label angle brackets and &, so that there is only this text in the code.
hint: If you want readers to see the six characters ©, use & to write the &, followed by copy;.

example.note: software description will appear as <file> & <folder>. The reader can see their angle brackets and hyphens.
